name: Captain Kennedy
summary: First named tentatively — "I think" — at left in VN-0006, atop Núi Bà Đen: "captain Kennedy from Boston." The 2026-08-15 session added a firm, personal detail: Kennedy carried a Nikon F, took the jungle-patrol photograph of Larry with the captured prisoner (VN-0023), sent his film to Hawaii for developing, and let Larry photograph the returned print — which is how VN-0023 entered Larry's collection.
larrysRecollection: Left: I think is captain Kennedy from Boston. (VN-0006 Memories comment, 2026-08-13.) Picture taken by Captain Kennedy with his Nikon F... Captain Kennedy sent his pictures to Hawaii to develop and when he got them back, my father took a picture of his picture. (VN-0023 comments, relayed 2026-08-15.)
researchNotes: The VN-0023 attribution is stated without hedge and places Kennedy physically on patrol with Larry near the Special Forces camp — a stronger footing than the earlier 'I think' for VN-0006, though the two Kennedys have not been formally confirmed as the same man. A Boston captain around the Núi Bà Đen camp in 1965 becomes searchable once the unit context firms up; the Hawaii film-developing detail suggests personal connections or prior posting there.
